warhead.provenance: WDU-18/B penetrating blast-fragmentation warhead, 488 lb = 221 kg per OOB (csg-us-harpoon-designation, C-est). Explosive/case split, lethal radius, damage are engineering-estimate surrogates.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate impact/delay fuze scaffold typical of a penetrating anti-ship warhead.

_real_world.role: Anti-ship cruise missile, canister-launched from Mk 141 quad launchers
_real_world.guidance_real: Sea-skimming, radar-altimeter cruise; active radar terminal; sea-skim or pop-up attack profile; Block II+ adds GPS and datalink
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for anti-ship missiles; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory. Not fitted to Flight IIA DDGs or CVN-78; DDG-72 Mahan (Flight II) may retain 2x Mk 141 quad launchers (8 RGM-84) if not removed (whether retained is not public)

warhead.type.note: blast_fragmentation warhead per the WDU-18/B penetrating-warhead designation

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the ~67-120 nmi range band at the used ~240 m/s speed proxy

flight_model.max_speed.note: RAN (allied government, A) states 'high subsonic' only; ~0.75 Mach sea-level ~240 m/s used as engineering estimate

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; engineering estimate for a sea-skimming anti-ship cruise missile's terminal pop-up/weave maneuver

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with max_g for an anti-ship cruise missile

guidance.type.note: active radar terminal homing per OOB; ActiveRadar is the matching real engine seeker_type

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public active-radar seeker acquisition range for Harpoon; engineering estimate typical of a ship-sized anti-ship-missile active-radar seeker

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; record has no functional mount regardless

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled for this mechanism-gap weapon

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; no public guidance-law constant, set for a sea-skimming anti-ship cruise missile's terminal homing

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, consistent with engaging a maneuvering surface target; not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; no public figure

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold consistent with flight_model.max_g

warhead.mass_kg.note: 488 lb = 221 kg, WDU-18/B; USN does not publish this directly (Tier C-est)

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 221 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.case_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split, see explosive_mass_kg; case mass set relatively high consistent with the WDU-18/B's penetrating-warhead design intent

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation projection-geometry template

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: copied/scaled from the aim_120c.json template pattern for this warhead's lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the aim_120c.json template pattern

fuze.type.note: no public fuze timing data; contact fuze is the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family for a penetrating anti-ship warhead's impact/delay exploder, per the loader's 4-value fuze.type vocabulary

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: 0.0 consistent with a contact-fuze trigger radius

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate impact/delay fuze scaffold typical of a penetrating anti-ship warhead

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: No functional mount exists (mechanism gap); content-only for _real_world.weapon_inventory. Per OOB, DDG-51 Flight IIA (DDG-81 Winston S. Churchill) is NOT fitted with Harpoon; only Flight II (DDG-72 Mahan) may retain it, count uncertain.
